This app uses language models to detect text. By default, it uses a fast English model which may miss some text. To use high-accuracy models or detect other languages, download them from the
with /model command, e.g. /model english and import them below.
Does this app upload my searched images anywhere other than search engines?

Yes! ✅
Your images are uploaded to LitterBox and Catbox third-party services to generate image url.

• Litterbox → Auto-delete image after 1 hour
• Catbox → Used only when Litterbox fails (stores image forever)

Important: Litterbox is actually part of Catbox.
They belong to the same service family and may use similar infrastructure.
Why does this app upload my image at all?
Search engines don\'t allow apps to directly upload images Programmatically (to prevent misuse & abuse). So the app uploads your image first to create a safe, usable link/url of image.

They're widely trusted for temporary file hosting because:

• No account & API is required
• Anonymous uploads are supported
• Simple, fast and reliable

They are not open-source, so please read their official data and privacy policies to fully understand how your data is handled.
Should I search personal or private images?
Please don\'t! 🙏\n\nAvoid uploading personal photos, private documents, IDs, or anything sensitive. Only search images that are safe and non-personal.
Does the app store my images or links?
Nope! \u2705\n\nYour images and URLs are not stored, tracked, or logged by this app.
Can the developer see my images or links?

No. Never.

This App:
• Has no server
• Does not store images
• Does not store image URLs
• Does not track what you search
• Does not collect data

Your data stays between you → Catbox/Litterbox → Search engine.
Your searched images can remain on search engine servers, Catbox servers, caches, and backups. This is why you should never upload private or personal images.

YomiLens uses the accessibility service for one thing: capturing a screenshot when you start a lookup. The screenshot never leaves your device — Japanese text is recognised and looked up entirely offline. The service cannot read your app content or type for you.
